universe.historical_universe: identity-verified securities represented in the current local panel; known incomplete point-in-time universe
universe.historical_market_cap_filter: unavailable; do not backfill current market cap

prior_activity.proxy: cross-sectional percentile of 20-session close-to-close realized volatility
prior_activity.interpretation: price-activity proxy only; not turnover, attention, or institutional flow

market_state.stress: 20-session return <= -0.05 OR drawdown from trailing 60-session highest close <= -0.10

entry.confirmation: within next 5 sessions, first close > prior session high and > own open; enter at following session open
